description: Display actions and what both validators make of them. validation.ts (the page) and visual_protocol.rs (the service) each run every case: apps/frontend/tests/unit/validatorCorpus.test.ts and agrees_with_the_shared_validator_corpus in apps/backend/tests/test_visual_protocol.rs. A case names its exact `error`, or is `accepted`; `normalized` is the validated action when it is not the action as sent. An accepted action must also pass a second time, unchanged, since the page validates what the service normalized. {"$repeat": s, "times": n} stands for s repeated n times. The rules both follow, with the order of the checks, the order of the keys and the whitespace set, are in docs/display-tool.md ("How the two validators agree"). The skill module's outline check runs the same cases (skills/switchboard/tests/test_switchboard.py), every refused case also goes through a display call (display_protocol_rejects_invalid_actions in apps/backend/tests/test_module_calls.rs), and docs/display-action-v1.schema.json is held to the corpus (apps/frontend/tests/unit/schema.test.ts). An action JSON cannot hold (a NaN or an infinity) is in display-actions.json instead.
